models.notes: Operator-owned id: set this to the exact model your client reports for the session. Verified against grok CLI 1.0.5 on 2026-08-29, which offers exactly grok-4.6 and grok-4.5; the previous entries (grok-4-fast, grok-4) matched no model that client can select, so an ingest naming them recorded a model nobody played. Sessions arrive via `npm run playtest:ingest` and are recorded as operator_attested.

Operator-owned id: the client's default and newest model, so it carries the reference tier. A reference-tier report is one of the two ways a single-vendor corpus can reach `corroborated` — the other being two distinct model families — which is why the tier assignment here is load-bearing rather than cosmetic.
